item.title: DuraGrip® Brand - 5/8" - Electrically Conductive Hook
item.description:
DuraGrip® brand Electrically Conductive Hook is coated in liquid silver to optimize conductivity. With resistivity of 1.8 Ohms per square inch, this 5/8-inch hook fastener produces 0.8 Ohms of resistivity during closure (when mated with 5/8" electrically conductive loop tape) and is great for anti-static applications, such as clean room environments or electronic assembly plants, where workers may be tethered in order to ground them. The military also has use for this silver conductive hook tape, using it to shield tents and other equipment from outside radio frequencies.
Sold by the yard, 10 yard minimum

Ideal for RF/EMI shielding and grounding straps

item.title: Luggage Strap and Belt
item.description:
The last luggage strap you'll ever need!
Keep your underwear from flying out when the airport mishandles your baggage! This suitcase strap is reinforced with polypropylene webbing, uses bright neon hook and loop fasteners, and features a press buckle release for easy and secure use.
This strap is ideal for overstuffed suitcases and carry on travel bags so you can avoid those pesky fees for oversized baggage. This strap pays for itself in a single trip!
Also perfect for securing coolers and other containers from blowing open on the road or at the campsite. item.title: Sports and Fishing Towel
item.description:
This cloth sports towel comes with a hook and loop strap and clasp, making it easy to attach to your belt while you're playing any sport. No more ruining your shirt or pants by wiping your hands on them. You can use the strap to fasten the towel to your golf bag, boat deck, golf cart, sports carry bag, exercise equipment and more. When attached to your gym bag so you never forget your towel again! The possibilities are endless when you have this versatile towel with clip!

item.description:

This remote strap for GoPro is available in two different sizes, these straps use stretch loop for a comfortable and snug fit that you can strap onto your wrist or bicep. item.title: 5/8" - DuraGrip® Brand Cinch Strap - 7" Length
item.description:
The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi
Withstand Temperatures up to 300 F , Part Number:V10C90BL, Color:Black, Strap Type:Cinch Strap, Brand:VELCRO®, Sold In Quantity:Sold Individually, 25 Strap Minimum, Color:Black, Width:1", Product Type:Straps

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi
Withstand Temperatures up to 300 F , Part Number:V15B74BL, Color:Black, Strap Type:Back Strap, Brand:VELCRO®, Sold In Quantity:Sold Individually, 25 Strap Minimum, Color:Black, Product Type:Straps

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
DuraGrip brand material is manufactured overseas and offers the best combination of strength, cycle life and price.
Made from 100% Nylon
Operating Temp.: -60 F to 280 F

This adhesive strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi
Withstand Temperatures up to 300 F , Part Number:V15F33BL, Color:Black, Strap Type:Face Strap, Brand:VELCRO®, Sold In Quantity:Sold Individually, 25 Strap Minimum, Color:Black, Product Type:Straps

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi

They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.

These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi

The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.

Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi

The cinch strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are both facing the same direction. The cinch strap also includes a plastic rectangular ring that is attached to the loop end opposite the portion of hook. These straps are ideal for bundling pipes, cables, hose, and other items. They also allow for a tighter, more secure closure.
The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.
6 mil Monofilament
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi
Closure Tension Strength: 6.5 psi

The Back Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing opposite directions. This acts as a cuff or band and is used in the same applications as a cinch strap.
The Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at one end, where the hook and loop are facing the same direction. This is basically a cinch strap without the ring. These straps are used in rehabilitation facilities for arthritis or are bolted or secured to medical braces as closures. They can also be used to suspend cabling and other wires.
The Two Way Face Strap is a length of loop with a short portion of hook attached at both ends, where the hook portions and the loop are all facing the same direction. This strap is often used to connect two items or to provide an adjustable closure to something, like a watch face, a medical brace, or rifle cheek rests.
VELCRO® Brand hook and loop is manufactured in the USA and offers fine quality and good strength.

DuraGrip brand adhesive backed hook and loop fasteners come with two different options. There is a rubber based adhesive and an acrylic based adhesive. There are a few key differences between the rubber and acrylic adhesives, including tackiness, temperature range and the best substrates.
The adhesive backed hook and loop sides are sold separately on the roll - be sure to order both sides if needed.
Peel-and-stick hook and loop is an ideal alternative for light-to-moderate duty applications such as adhering headliners in boats and automobiles, hanging information at tradeshows, warehouse labeling, or storage for such things as remote controls and light-weight tools. The advantage of using peel-and-stick hook and loop is that it provides an alternative to a mechanical fastener such as nails and screws; the adhesive bond, is strong and reliable.
Some of the differences between Rubber and Acrylic adhesives include operating temperature range, how they hold up to moisture and chemicals, and how well they bond to various substrates.
The material used to manufacture our peel-and-stick hook and loop products is of the highest quality, and will retain its strength over 10,000 cycles and more. We carry peel-and-stick hook and loop products from DuraGrip and VELCRO® Brand in sheets of varying widths and strength ratings, so you can choose the one most suitable for your uses. The sheets can be cut to various shapes for specific applications. Various colors are also available from which to choose. You will find peel-and-stick hook and loop to be safe and economical to use.
We offer over 15 colors in 1", 1.5" and 2" peel and stick hook and loop. These DuraGrip brand adhesive fasteners may require a lead time of up to 4 business days.
We also offer the 6-inch Hook and Loop for $11.74 per yard.

item.title: DuraGrip® Brand Electrically Conductive Hook and Loop

description.p: DuraGrip® Brand electrically conductive hook and loop tape is coated in liquid silver to optimize conductivity. With resistivity of 1.4 Ohms per square inch, this product produces 0.8 Ohms of resistivity during closure (when mated with Hook) and is great for anti-static applications, such as clean room environments or electronic assembly plants, where workers may be tethered in order to ground them. The military also has use for electrically conductive hook and loop tape, using it to shield tents and other equipment from outside radio frequencies.
This material is manufactured at 16mm, 30mm, and 50mm widths, which aligns most closely with the 5/8", 1", and 2" widths. The 1" option may measure closer to 1 3/16".

item.title: Chair Strapping for Social Distancing Solutions

description.p: As most establishments start to reopen, we have the perfect strap to keep your patrons, customers, and fans socially distant. These low cost, easy to use straps are your best option to mark off seating for social distancing protocols.

Easy to use in stadiums, church pews, arenas, theaters, auditoriums, classrooms, restaurants and any other place where people gather. These can be custom made to fit special seating like benches, booths, and church pews.

This strap comes with a "Reserved for SOCIAL DISTANCING" sign made of RP Weatherproof plastic. The sign is 3.5" x 8.5" with two precut slits to feed the strap through. Slits can accommodate up to 2" widths!
These straps are manufactured with DuraGrip Brand hook and loop fasteners available in any of our 25 colors. The strap can also be made with VELCRO® Brand fasteners.

These work great in conjunction with other virus prevention efforts like proper PPE face masks and face shields, hand washing, and social distancing.
This strap is 1" x 100" and includes the social distancing sign. , Part Number:SOCIAL CHAIR STRAP, Color:Red, Strap Type:Back Strap, Brand:DuraGrip, Sold In Quantity:100 Inches, Hook or Loop?:Hook & Loop, Width:1", Product Type:Straps

item.title: VELCRO® Brand - 1.5" White Hook Sew-On
item.description:
The white VELCRO® Brand Hook 88 Woven Nylon Sew-On fasteners are woven with 6 mil Monofilament and are binder coated to protect against fraying when cut. This sew-on woven nylon tape also offers excellent durability, can withstand high temperatures (270 F to 300 F), and has a high cycle life. Use in conjunction with the VELCRO® Brand Loop 3610 fastener.
Closure Peel Strength: 1.2 psi
Closure Shear Strength: 14.0 psi

item.title: DuraGrip® Brand - 60" White Tempo Display Loop Fabric
item.description:
Details: 100% nylon fabric laminated to loop with polyester foam core and nylon jersey backing. Designed for engagement with a variety of hook fasteners. Tempo laminated loop fabric can be used in trade show booths, display booths, jewelry cases, medical applications, classroom display boards and much more!
Tested Toughness: This fabric has been tested by an independent testing laboratory against standards for upholstery fabrics set by the National Association of Furniture Manufacturers.
Flame Retardancy: This fabric has the following flame resistant characteristics:
Flame spread rate of 25
Fuel contributing factor of 15
Smoke density factor of 20
